keepsake.label: A clipping with the hero's face

valley.drawingAlt: A printing press under a big lens. The page it prints shows your face.
locals: The gazette only prints a quarrel. Kind days do not sell.
Nobody reads about a kind day. I had one yesterday, and nobody asked.
Quill is tired of the press, but Quill keeps turning the handle.

notes.title: You were this sky
notes.science: In Part 1 your light was the attention, and whatever you lit grew.
notes.limits: Here the sky looks only for drama, and it prints one story a day.
notes.counter: Attention can also lift a kind act into view.
notes.question: What did you shine on in Kith?

sources.label: Emotion Shapes the Diffusion of Moralized Content, Brady and others, 2017
Moral Outrage in the Digital Age, Crockett, 2017

notes.title: What the gazette prints
notes.science: A paper that prints only quarrels makes quarrels look common. Online, false news and angry news travel further than true, calm news.
notes.limits: Real news has many reasons for what it covers.
notes.counter: Some papers print the quiet stories too, and people read them.
notes.question: What never makes the front page?

sources.label: The Spread of True and False News Online, Vosoughi, Roy and Aral, 2018
Out-Group Animosity Drives Engagement on Social Media, Rathje, Van Bavel and van der Linden, 2021
